calls.reason: A 'will never' forecast can't be confirmed. The only candidate counterexample, MIT's SEAL preprint, is a research prototype its authors call a promising step, not a deployed model, so the claim is neither confirmed nor refuted.

'Don't work at all' reads as rhetoric. The evidence is mixed: CRMArena-Pro shows about 35% multi-turn success, but METR shows frontier agents finishing roughly 50-minute tasks half the time. That is real but unreliable capability, so neither reading clearly holds or fails.

The main point, no profit, held. Reported figures show OpenAI with a $13.5B net loss and an ~$8B operating loss in H1 2025, and Anthropic with a $42B net loss and an $8.1B operating loss in 2025, per its leaked prospectus. The $40B revenue figure was only a hedged estimate.
